BCCI outlines long-term career plan for cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has revealed a long-term career plan for cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi following a review meeting at its Mumbai headquarters. The board aims to guide Sooryavanshi to build a career comparable to Sachin Tendulkar, emphasizing sustained performance and avoiding becoming a "one-series or one-year wonder." BCCI Secretary stated the intention is for Sooryavanshi to "serve like Sachin Tendulkar."
